notes: Installs of 2026.11.20 upgrade by running the installer again: curl -fsSL https://get.aidenhq.ai | sh (as the same user, on the server). Later releases update themselves again.
Every task shows one state the kernel works out from what happened (working, waiting on whom, idle and why, done): on the board, in the task tools and in Telegram /status and /waiting
Agents act instead of setting a status: task_block, task_cancel, task_delegate wait, task_comment reopen; a question to the owner is an open wait that their reply ends
No task sits idle unexplained after an agent is retired: its open tasks move to its successor's backlog with one triage task
Grading holds, CI and merge-queue waits show as waiting, not idle; a chat run that ends without a reply shows as failed
Under auto-updates, an official release is AI-reviewed for malice only, reading every authority line whole; no owner tap for its new authority
One apply queue: callers wait their turn; apply rebuilds, restarts and snapshots only what a change touches
Public HTTPS by default off a tailnet; --exposure switches mode
The fleet merges and closes on maintained repos; pr-watch owns Dependabot PRs
Fleet Steward detects unstarted delegations, merge deadlocks, ping-pong, duplicates and stale owner cards
Self-hosted Primer: editor polish, automatic checkpoints, suggesting; agents work on Primer documents directly
